title: Ruth Paine at Naushon Island retreat with Dulles's mistress

tellings.quote: Yeah. No, this is correct. Um, she actually vacationed the summer of 1963 at a place called Nashon Island, which is right up near Martha's Vineyard in Massachusetts.

plain: Ruth Paine, a figure in the story of President Kennedy's assassination, is said to have spent the summer of 1963 on Naushon Island, near Martha's Vineyard in Massachusetts, a retreat linked to the Forbes family, in the company of Mary Bancroft, the mistress of former CIA director Allen Dulles. A researcher named Dan Sheehan confirms this on the show without naming a source. He tells it to suggest a link between Paine and the circle around Dulles.
